user_direction: Use available machine resources when no concurrent build is running.

running_datadog_matrix.decision: Keep the already-running matrix at its recorded resource limits so control, writer and reader comparisons remain matched. Do not restart or change limits midway.

future_standalone_work: Use available CPU and memory for standalone source builds or standalone workload runs; check active Bazel processes first. Keep memory headroom for the OS, JVM and agents. Performance comparisons use the same resource policy on both sides.
rejected: Changing only the current single writer or reader to unrestricted resources would confound this matrix and would not improve single-threaded repository extraction.
